title: 1 Banana Variety Supplies 99% Of Exports
hook: Bananas look diverse, but 99% of exports are one variety.
closing: Genetic sameness makes the global banana supply efficient, familiar, and dangerously fragile.
question: Would you try another banana variety?

segments.say: The Cavendish supplies 99% of exported bananas. Grocery-store variety is mostly an illusion.
More than 1,000 banana varieties exist. Global exports still depend on a single clone.
The disease reached 3 continents. Genetic uniformity lets one threat spread across the same weakness.
